qr_count.Description: Number of unique QR code records found in the injected recording

qr_first_trigger_offset.LongName: Offset of the first QR trigger event in seconds
qr_first_trigger_offset.Description: Time from the start of the injected recording to the QR code carrying the first 'trigger' event

qr_first_trigger_abstime.LongName: Clock time of the first QR trigger event
qr_first_trigger_abstime.Description: Clock time of day (no date), as parsed from the QR code, when the first 'trigger' event was received
